record.question: No load current in a transformer:
options: lags the applied voltage by somewhat less than 90°
leads the applied voltages by somewhat less than 90°
record.explanation: No-load current comprises magnetizing current (lags by 90°) and core-loss current (in phase with voltage). The resultant current lags the applied voltage by somewhat less than 90°.
